version_note: v2 (2026-09-30, GOAL-M2-BRIDGE-001 epoch 5, worker B5) applies the two operator-authorized contract changes to v1 and nothing else. (1) Universe transcription repair: the v1 clause 'Issue Sub-Type=C' is a transcription artefact - ITCH Appendix E defines Sub-Type C='Common Shares' and Z='Not Applicable', and Nasdaq marks ordinary common stock with Issue Classification=C, Issue Sub-Type=Z, so v1 admits 31 of 12,809 locates in the 2026-06-12 session while the zero-share/zero-price cross prints concentrate in the non-Nasdaq-listed market categories. The corrected clause is Authenticity=P, ETP Flag=N, Issue Classification=C, Market Category in {Q,G,S} (Nasdaq-listed common stock), rule identity NASDAQ-CLOSING-CROSS-PIT-STOCK-DIRECTORY-v2; it admits 2,483 locates. This is a defect fix, not universe shopping: the v1 clause text is retained below at universe.clause_v1_retained, and both admitted counts are reported. (2) Completeness contract: the zero-length-terminator expectation is replaced by transport markers plus a measurement-window continuity and coverage certificate, with the v1 clause text retained at timestamp_contract.v1_retained. The frozen measurement itself (mechanism, signal, timing, outcome, metric, kill rule) is UNCHANGED from v1; only these two contract defects are repaired.
provenance_note: Retargeted 2026-09-29 from TUP-NASDAQ-ANYCAP-H4-AUCTION-AGG, where this frozen formulation was first attached, to the narrowed candidate row TUP-NASDAQ-CLOSE-H4-LATENOII-AGG (DECISIONS D-0041). The parent row stays registered as the historical provenance of the broad ANYCAP/unspecified-order-type formulation, with its own recorded verdict; this spec no longer describes it. Nothing in the frozen formulation below changed in the retarget - the freeze, universe rule, timestamp contract, execution boundary, prerequisite, metric and kill rule are the text frozen before the retarget. v2 (2026-09-30) repairs the universe transcription and the completeness contract only; see version_note. The v1 bytes are retained verbatim at M2/experiments/M2-BRIDGE-AUCTION-LATENOII-MATERIALITY/spec_prev_retained.json, sha256 5ef1dcac96e80847069006d24477dc12226f4d907b8798a522c63c14ff6e8694.
mechanism: Signed late NOII imbalance change as causal pressure on Nasdaq Closing Cross clearing displacement.
mechanism_boundary: This is not an indicative-price, post-close reversal, or benchmark-flow strategy; those mechanisms are out of scope.

freeze.early_observation: Last eligible NOII I message with Cross Type C and exchange timestamp t < 15:50:00 ET; if no exact boundary message exists, first message at or after 15:50 is used.
freeze.late_observation: Last eligible NOII I message with Cross Type C and exchange timestamp t <= 15:55:00 ET.
freeze.sign: Direction B = +ImbalanceShares; Direction S = -ImbalanceShares; N/O/P is missing and ineligible.
freeze.optional_scale: delta_imbalance / max(PairedShares_15:55, 1), declared before replay and not tuned.
freeze.outcome_source: Cross Trade Q with Cross Type C after the 16:00 close.

universe.membership: The same date's TotalView-ITCH Stock Directory spin.
universe.issue_sub_type_v2: unrestricted (the v1 constraint 'Issue Sub-Type=C' is retained below and marked as the repaired defect; the 2026-06-12 session marks ordinary common stock as Issue Classification=C with Issue Sub-Type=Z)

clause_v1_retained.supersession_reason: Transcription defect, not universe shopping: ITCH Appendix E defines Sub-Type C='Common Shares' and Z='Not Applicable', and the dominant classification/sub-type pair among Nasdaq-listed common stock in this session is C/Z (4,183 locates) against C/C (31). Zero-share and zero-price Closing Cross prints concentrate in the non-Nasdaq-listed market categories, so the uncorrected clause also admits the bulk of the unprintable crosses.

universe.identity: Date-specific symbol and Stock Locate; no cross-date survivor list or current constituent list.
required_events: Cross Trade Q Cross Type C
universe.survivorship_control: Delisted, renamed, halted, and acquired securities remain eligible only for the dates on which the date-specific directory qualifies them.

timestamp_contract.event_clock: Nasdaq exchange nanoseconds since midnight; retain raw timestamp and convert session display to ET only for schedule checks.
timestamp_contract.ordering: Retain feed sequence/tracking metadata and packet-gap status.

v1_retained.invalid_day: Missing required NOII/cross messages, unresolved duplicate ordering, or unrepaired feed gap invalidates the day.

completeness_contract_v2.transport_markers: gzip CRC32 and ISIZE verified; received bytes equal the server's Content-Range total; zero framing errors; zero trailing bytes after the last frame; final frame is the ITCH 5.0 'C' End of Messages system event. The BinaryFILE v1.00 zero-length terminator is NOT expected: it is absent from Nasdaq's published captures, and its absence is a recorded provider-format finding, never the completeness test.
completeness_contract_v2.transport_markers_are_not_completeness: The transport markers prove the retained object is intact; they do NOT prove the original session was captured whole. That is exactly why the certificate below exists.
completeness_contract_v2.measurement_window_continuity_certificat: Over 15:49:50-16:00:10 ET, on the retained object: exchange timestamps non-decreasing in stream order; every inter-message gap whose BOTH endpoints lie inside the window is bounded (<= 1 s); the window carries at least 1,000,000 messages and at least one certified in-window pair.
completeness_contract_v2.coverage_certificate: Per-symbol Closing-Cross NOII cadence inside the signal interval 15:50:00-15:55:00 ET (no missed dissemination cycle: gap <= 1.5 x the observed 10 s period) and an input-availability coverage ratio of universe-qualified symbols with a valid Closing Cross at or above 0.95, with the missingness audit reported by identity and reason.
completeness_contract_v2.out_of_window_holes: Declared non-material to this branch's inputs: no frozen signal instant, entry instant or exit print lies outside the window, and a book reconstructed from the window alone cannot observe pre-window state in any case.
completeness_contract_v2.negative_control: The certificate is proven load-bearing against the known splice attack (.research/m2_bridge_001/verification/V2/v2_auction_contract_attack.py): the spliced, re-compressed tape passes every transport marker and is refused by the certificate.

timestamp_contract.invalid_day: Missing required NOII/cross messages, unresolved duplicate ordering, a failed measurement-window continuity certificate, or an unmet coverage floor invalidates the measurement (named clause, never a silent re-scope).

execution.precursor: Observation-only gross materiality measurement; no order, account, route, or paper trade.
execution.later_separate_test: If separately authorized, test a Market-On-Close order submitted after the 15:55 freeze through an exchange-member route; LOC is a separate protocol and is not included here.

external_prerequisite: One regular month or 20 consecutive regular sessions of raw TotalView-ITCH 5.0 captures including the daily spin and 15:49:50-16:00:10 ET for all symbols, I/Q messages, nanosecond timestamps, sequence/packet identifiers, gap/retransmission metadata, retention/correction policy, delivery terms, and price.
primary_metric: Gross clearing displacement conditional on the frozen signed late imbalance change, with coverage and confidence interval.
kill_rule: Do not replay if historical NOII/ITCH retention, fields, timestamps, identity, or sequence completeness cannot be verified.
continuation_rule: Only after the historical sample passes the timestamp, identity, gap, and completeness contract may a gross precursor run be authorized; execution economics remain a later separate gate.
